name: Security/Identity Context
rationale: Every other context relies on it via a Shared Kernel for session/identity; also contains the CRITICAL authentication bypass (no password check) and hard-coded SSN encryption key, which must be fixed before any other context can be considered safe to build on.

name: Employee Management Context
rationale: Root aggregate (Employee/EMPLOYEES, EMPLOYEE_HISTORY) supplies master data to Leave, Payroll, and Performance via Customer/Supplier relationships; its broken TRG_EMP_BEFORE_UPDATE trigger (blocks transfer/promote/terminate/rehire) is a hard blocker for any downstream lifecycle-dependent feature and must be resolved right after identity is trustworthy.

name: Action Audit Logging (cross-cutting)
rationale: PKG_AUDIT.log_action is a cross-cutting concern invoked by security and employee lifecycle operations; it currently swallows constraint-violation errors, so it should be hardened once its two known callers (Security, Employee) are stabilized and before new write-heavy contexts (Leave, Payroll, Performance) start generating audit volume.

name: Leave Management Context
rationale: Consumes Employee master data and Security sessions; has the most existing (if partial) evidence of any downstream context — submission/self-cancellation already work — and the manager approve/reject gap is a well-defined, high-confidence build target, making it the most tractable next context.

name: Payroll Context
rationale: Also consumes Employee master data via Customer/Supplier dependency; sequenced after Leave because payroll runs typically need approved leave/attendance data as an input and because Payroll has lower evidence confidence (name only), requiring more discovery work best done after the better-evidenced Leave context is settled.

name: Performance Context
rationale: Lowest evidence confidence (name only, no table or service evidence) and least time-sensitive value stream (Review Cycle/Individual Review); placed last so discovery and design can draw on patterns and glossary established while building the better-evidenced Leave and Payroll contexts.
